translation: Sobre mim ⟨estão⟩ ⟨os⟩ votos, Elohim: pagarei ⟨as⟩ tuas promessas com confissões ⟨de louvor⟩ a ti.

tokens.rationale: עלי usually means 'upon me' or 'over me', here indicating the vows rest upon the speaker
Preserving the Hebrew divine name Elohim rather than translating as 'Deus' to maintain Tanaj-primeiro discipline
Literally 'tuas promessas' or 'teus votos'; English requires article
Shallam means to pay, complete, or make whole; here fulfilling vows. English article added
Todah literally means 'thanksgiving' or 'confession'; implies praise offerings
Prepositional suffix 'to you', direct object of the praise
